input.quote: the validity, interpretation and legal effect of this Agreement shall be governed by the internal laws of the State of New York, U.S.A., applicable to contracts entered in and performed entirely within the State of New York, U.S.A. without regard to any conflict of law principles.
input.rationale: The governing-law provision selects the internal laws of the State of New York, and the venue provision requires any suit to be instituted in the City of New York with irrevocable submission to the exclusive jurisdiction of the SDNY or the New York state courts, plus waiver of venue/forum non conveniens objections. A document-wide search returns no arbitration clause, so disputes proceed in courts rather than any offshore arbitral seat. This matches the playbook preferred position (New York law; exclusive jurisdiction of state and federal courts in New York), so no redline is needed.
